title: Empire of Storms
author: Sarah J. Maas
summary: Book five of Throne of Glass. With a great war closing in, a queen and her allies sail abroad to look for help while the darkness grows at home.
readIf: you want an expansive, high-stakes installment full of battles and alliances.
skipIf: you have not read the previous books, or want a quieter fantasy.

pairings.reason: Another fantasy where a gathering of allies faces a final war against ancient evil.
A huge-scale fantasy with a heavy focus on war and the characters who carry it.
A lighter young-adult fantasy of rebellion against a ruling class with unusual powers.
